title: dyssodia ciliosa
intro: Dyssodia ciliosa, commonly known as Mexican daisy or yellow daisy, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Dyssodia ciliosa include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can help soothe wounds, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress.
